toolsPreview.name: search-jobs-tool
toolsPreview.description: Semantic + structured search over Hosco hospitality jobs. Mirrors the smart filtering and ranking from hosco-v2: hard-excludes private/expired/inactive postings, supports visibility/promotion/external filters, configurable language matching (subset/any/all), and the v2 "suggested" ordering (relevance → Hosco-native → VIP → freshness). Returns ranked matches with relevance scores.

toolsPreview.name: list-jobs-tool
toolsPreview.description: List the most recently published Hosco jobs, paginated. Use this when no semantic search is needed — for natural-language search, use the search jobs tool instead.

toolsPreview.name: job-details-tool
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the full details of a single Hosco job by its slug or numeric id. Use this after a search/list result to retrieve the full description, requirements, benefits, and all other available fields.
